svg.desc: Paid for by the Source, Reference: Across the 61 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes programme inflation by 0.14 to 0.17 points a year; no material change in programme inflation at the main row (0.15 points a year; materiality 1.00), seed interval 0.15 to 0.15. Paid for by the Source, Adverse: Across the 61 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes programme inflation by 0.18 to 0.22 points a year; no material change in programme inflation at the main row (0.18 points a year; materiality 1.00), seed interval 0.18 to 0.18. Paid for by the Source, Stress: Across the 61 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes programme inflation by 0.18 to 0.22 points a year; no material change in programme inflation at the main row (0.18 points a year; materiality 1.00), seed interval 0.18 to 0.18. Paid for by a contribution, Reference: Across the 116 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes programme inflation by 0.01 to 382.13 points a year; no material change in programme inflation at the main row (0.14 points a year; materiality 1.00), seed interval 0.14 to 0.14. Paid for by a contribution, Adverse: Across the 116 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes programme inflation by 0.05 to 466.00 points a year; no material change in programme inflation at the main row (0.16 points a year; materiality 1.00), seed interval 0.15 to 0.16. Paid for by a contribution, Stress: Across the 116 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes programme inflation by 0.02 to 480.84 points a year; no material change in programme inflation at the main row (0.13 points a year; materiality 1.00), seed interval 0.12 to 0.13.
svg.title: Programme inflation: the C2.2 design against no programme, 20 years
svg.text: Programme inflation: the C2.2 design against no programme, 20 years
Each dot is one preregistered reading, sorted by its effect, with its 95% seed interval (unit: points a year).
Ringed: the main row. Diamond: the least-favourable bound. Shaded: not material (rule 3). Below each panel: the curve's verdict (rule 2).
Paid for by the Source (main row: full backing, a design parameter)
Paid for by a contribution (the financed rows)
